goal: Classify a free-text request into one of two categories and prepare a reviewed response.
description: Each category has its own approval and response step.

step_intents.name: Classify request
step_intents.purpose: Classify the request content into two named categories.

step_intents.name: Approve urgent handling
step_intents.purpose: Human approval before the first category response.

step_intents.name: Prepare urgent response
step_intents.purpose: Prepare the first category response after approval.

step_intents.name: Approve routine handling
step_intents.purpose: Human approval before the second category response.

step_intents.name: Prepare routine response
step_intents.purpose: Prepare the second category response after approval.
